title: Normal force calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the normal force exerted by the track on B at the bottom using Newton's second law for circular motion.

title: Energy conservation for velocity
description: Essential: Applies conservation of mechanical energy to find the initial speed of B at the bottom of the track.

title: Friction heat determination
description: Important: Correctly calculates the heat generated from friction between B and C using the work-energy theorem and relative displacement.

title: Acceleration analysis
description: Important: Correctly determines the accelerations of B and C on the ground using Newton's second law and friction forces.

title: Kinematic sequence timing
description: Important: Correctly breaks down the motion into phases (C stopping, B sliding, collision, post-collision stop) and applies kinematic equations.

title: Collision momentum conservation
description: Important: Applies conservation of momentum to find the velocity of B and C after they stick together.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (m, kg, s, N, J) throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration (e.g., treating deceleration as positive without proper sign convention in kinematics).

title: Friction force confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses which friction coefficient (μ₁ or μ₂) applies to which interface or miscalculates the net force on C.
